question: A can complete one - third of a work in 10 days and B can do 3/5<sup>th </sup>of the same work in 24 days. They worked together for 10 days. The remaining work was completed by C alone in 15 days. In how many days can C alone do 2/3<sup>rd</sup> of the same work?
question_hi: A 10 दिनों में एक कार्य का एक-तिहाई क पूरा कर सकता है और B उसी कार्य के 3/5 भाग को 24 दिनों में कर सकता है। उन्होंने 10 दिनों तक एक साथ काम किया। शेष कार्य C ने अकेले 15 दिनों में पूरा किया। तो, C अकेले कितने दिनों में उसी कार्य का 2/3 कार्य कर सकता है?
solution:
Given:

A can complete 1/3 of a work in 10 days

⇒ A can complete the whole work in 10 × 3 = 30 days

B can complete 3/5 of the work in = 24 days

⇒ B can do the whole work in 24 × 5/3 = 40 days

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency × Time

Calculation:

Let the total work = LCM of (30, 40) = 120

Work done by A and B in 10 days = (4 + 3) × 10 = 70

Remaining work = 120 - 70 = 50

Now, let efficiency of C be x, then

⇒ 15x = 50

⇒ x = 50/15 = 10/3

2/3 of the total work = 120 × 2/3 = 80

2/3 of the total work C alone can complete in = 80/(10/3) = 24 days

∴ The correct answer is 24 days.
solution_hi:
दिया है:

A 10 दिनों में 1/3 कार्य पूरा कर सकता है

⇒ A कुल कार्य को को कर सकता है 10 × 3 = 30 दिन में

B काम का 3/5 भाग पूरा कर सकता है= 24 दिन में

⇒ B कुल कार्य को कर सकता है 24 × 5/3 = 40 दिन में

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

सम्पूर्ण कार्य = दक्षता × समय

गणना:

माना सम्पूर्ण कार्य = (30, 40) का ल.स.प. = 120

A और B द्वारा 10 दिन में किया गया कार्य = (4 + 3) × 10 = 70

बाकि बचा कार्य = 120 - 70 = 50

माना C की दक्षता x है, तो

⇒ 15x = 50

⇒ x = 50/15 = 10/3

कुल कार्य का 2/3 भाग = 120 × 2/3 = 80

कुल कार्य का 2/3 Cअकेले पूरा कर सकता है = 80/(10/3) = 24 दिन में

∴ सही उत्तर 24 दिन है।

question: How many natural number up to 2001 divisible by 3 or 4 but NOT by 5?
question_hi: 2001 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याएँ 3 या 4 से विभाज्य हैं लेकिन 5 से नहीं?
solution:
Concept:

Numbers which are divisible by 'a' or 'b' = (Number divisible by 'a') + (Number divisible by 'b') - (Numbers divisible by lcm of 'a' and 'b')

Calculation:

Number which is divisible by 3 or 4 up to 2001 are = 2001/3 + 2001/4 - 2001/12 = 667 + 500 - 166 = 1001

Now,

Numbers which are divisible by 3 or 4 but not by 5 = (Numbers divisible by 3 or 4) - (Numbers divisible by lcm of 3 and 5) - (Numbers divisible by lcm of 4 and 5) + (Number divisible by lcm of 3, 4, and 5)

Numbers which is divisible by 3 or 4 but not by 5 up to 2001 are = 1001 - 2001/15 - 2001/20 + 2001/60 = 1001 - 133 - 100 + 33 = 801

∴ The correct answer is 801.
solution_hi:
अवधारणा:

वे संख्याएँ जो 'a' या 'b' से विभाज्य हैं = ('a' से विभाज्य संख्या) + ('b' से विभाज्य संख्या) - ('a' और 'b' के लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य से विभाज्य संख्याएँ)

गणना:

2001 तक 3 या 4 से विभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं = 2001/3 + 2001/4 - 2001/12 = 667 + 500 - 166 = 1001

अब,

वे संख्याएँ जो 3 या 4 से विभाज्य हैं लेकिन 5 से नहीं = (3 या 4 से विभाज्य संख्याएँ) - (Numbers divisible by lcm of 3 and 5) - (4 और 5 के लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य से विभाज्य संख्याएँ) + (3, 4, और 5 के लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य से विभाज्य संख्याएँ)

2001 तक वे संख्याएँ जो 3 या 4 से विभाज्य हैं लेकिन 5 से विभाज्य नहीं हैं = 1001 - 2001/15 - 2001/20 + 2001/60 = 1001 - 133 - 100 + 33 = 801

∴ सही उत्तर 801 है।

question: In ΔABC, ∠C = 90°. M and N are the mid-points of sides AB and AC, respectively. CM and BN intersect each other at D and ∠BDC = 90°. If BC = 8 cm, then the length of BN is;

CM and BN are median.

⇒ CM = AM = BM = 3x

⇒ AB = 6x

Let AC be 2z.

⇒ AN = CN = z

In ΔABC,

AB2 = AC2 + BC2

⇒ 36x2 = 4z2 + 64

⇒ 9x2 = z2 + 16    ----(1)

⇒ 64 = 6x2

⇒ x = 4√6/3

⇒ BN = 3x = 3 × (4√6/3) = 4√6

∴ The correct answer is 4√6 cm.

question: Two equal sum (in Rs.) are lent at 8% and 4% simple interest p.a. respectively at the same time. The first sum is received 2 years earlier than the other and the amount received in each case is Rs. 14,500. Each sum is:

solution:
Given:

P1 = P2, R1 = 8% and R2 = 4%

The first sum is collected 2 years earlier than the second

Formula used:

SI = (P × R × T)/100

Calculation:

Let Principal be p and time be t

According to the question

p + (p × 8 × t)/100 = p + (p × 4 × (t + 2)/100

Now, amount = 14500, R = 8%, and T = 2 years

⇒ 116% of P = 14500

⇒ P = 12500

question: In the figure, in ΔPQR, PT ⊥ QR at T and PS is the bisector of ∠QPR. If ∠PQR = 78°, and ∠TPS = 24°, then the measure of ∠PRQ is:

solution:

∠TPS = (∠TQP - ∠PRQ)/2

24 = (78 - ∠PRQ)/2

78 - ∠PRQ = 24 × 2 = 48

∠PRQ = 78 - 48 = 30

Alternate MethodGiven: 

 In ΔPQR, PT ⊥ QR at T and PS is the bisector of ∠QPR

Calculation:

In ΔPQT,

∠QPT = 180° - ∠PQR - ∠PTQ = 180° - 78° - 90° = 12°

∠SPQ = ∠QPT + ∠TPS = 12° + 24° = 36°

Since PS is the bisector of ∠QPR.

∠QPR = 2 × ∠SPQ = 2 × 36° = 72°

In ΔPQR,

∠PRQ = 180° - ∠PQR - ∠QPR = 180° - 78° - 72° = 30°

Hence the required answer is 30°

∴ The Required answer is 6.

question: Pipe A and B can empty a full tank in 18 hours and 24 hours, respectively. Pipe C alone can fill the tank in 36 hours. If the tank is 5/6 full and all the three pipes are opened together, then in how many hours will the tank be emptied?
question_hi: पाइप A और B क्रमशः 18 घंटे और 24 घंटे में एक पुरे भरे टैंक को खाली कर सकते हैं। अकेले पाइप C टैंक को 36 घंटे में भर सकता है। यदि टैंक 5/6 भरा हुआ है और सभी तीन पाइप एक साथ खोले दिए जाते हैं, तो टैंक कितने घंटों में खाली हो जाएगा?
solution:
Given:

Pipe A and B can empty a full tank in 18 hours and 24 hours.

Pipe C alone can fill the tank in 36 hours.

The tank is 5/6 full and all the three pipes are opened together.

Concept used:

Time required = Total work/Efficiency

Calculation:

Total work = 72

5/6 of total work = 72 × 5/6 = 60

If all three pipe open together then, 5/6 of the tank empty in = 60/(-4 -3 + 2) = 60/-5 = 12 hrs

question: The height of a cylinder is 2/3<sup>rd</sup> of its diameter. Its volume is equal to the volume of a sphere whose radius is 4 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm<sup>2</sup>) of the cylinder?

Calculation:

x = ∛(4 × 4 × 4)/(3 × 3 × 3) = 4/3

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2 πrh = 2π × 3x × 4x = 2π × 3 × 4/3 × 4 × 4/3 = 128 π/3

question: The average of 19 numbers is 22.8. The average of the first ten number is 18.4 and that of the last ten numbers is 28.6. If the 10<sup>th</sup> number is excluded from the given numbers, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
question_hi: 19 संख्याओं का औसत 22.8 है। पहली दस संख्याओं का औसत 18.4 है और अंतिम दस संख्याओं का औसत 28.6 है। यदि 10वीं संख्या को दी गयी संख्याओं से अलग रखा जाता है, तो शेष संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?
solution:
Average of 19 numbers = 22.8

Sum of the 19 numbers = 22.8 × 19 = 433.2

Average of next 10 numbers = 18.4

Sum of next 10 numbers = 18.4 × 10 = 184

Average of last 10 number = 28.6

Sum of last 10 number = 28.6 × 10 = 286

10th number = 286 + 184 – 433.2 = 36.8

Sum of 18 number = 433.2 – 36.8 = 396.4

Average of 18 number = 396.4/18 = 22

⇒ 14

10th Number = 14 + 22.8 = 36.8

Sum of the 19 numbers = 22.8 × 19 = 433.2

When 10th number excluded then,

Sum of 18 number = 433.2 – 36.8 = 396.4

Average of 18 number = 396.4/18 = 22

question: A train of length 342 m is running at 54 km/h. In how much time (in seconds) will it cross a bridge of length 438 m?
question_hi: 342 मीटर लंबाई की एक ट्रेन 54 किमी/घंटा की रफ़्तार चल रही है। कितने समय में (सेकंड में) यह 438 मीटर लंबाई के पुल को पार करेगी?
solution:
Given:-

A train length = 342 m

Train speed = 54 km/h

Bridge length = 438 m

Formula used:-

Time = Distance/Speed

Calculation:-

Speed of train = 54 km/h

Length of train = 54 × (5/18) = 15 m/s

Length of bridge = 438 m

∴ Total distance = Train length + Bridge length

Total length = 342 + 438 = 780

∴ Time = 780/15 = 52 sec

∴ The required time to cross a bridge is 52 sec.

पुल की लंबाई = 438 मीटर

∴ कुल दूरी = ट्रेन की लंबाई + पुल की लंबाई

कुल लंबाई = 342 + 438 = 780

∴ एक पुल को पार करने के लिए आवश्यक समय 52 सेकंड है।

question: 3 men and 5 women together can complete a work in 6 days, whereas 4 men and 9 women together can do it in 4 days. How many women are required to do the same work in 7 days?

Calculation:-

Let efficiency of 1 man and 1 woman be x and y respectively

As we know,

Total work = Total work

According to the question

18x + 30y = 16x + 36y

n = 84/7 = 12

∴ Required number of women is 12.

question: The sides of a triangular field are 120 m, 170 m and 250 cost of levelling the field at the rate of Rs. 7.40/m<sup>2</sup> is:

Cost of levelling 1 m2 = Rs. 7.40

∴ Required cost of leveling is 66000.

question: If 50% of the employees in office E are transferred to office D, then what percentage of the total number of employees of the company is the number of employees in office D?
question_hi: यदि कार्यालय E के 50% कर्मचारियों को कार्यालय D में स्थानांतरित किया जाता है, तो कार्यालय D में कर्मचारियों की संख्या, कुल कर्मचारियों की संख्या का कितना प्रतिशत है?
solution:
Calculation:-

Total employees = 360°

Number of employees in company E = 64.8°

Number of employees in company D = 57.6°

If 50% employees of company E transferred to company D, then number of employees in company D = 57.6° + 64.8°/2 = 57.6° + 32.4° = 90°

Required percentage = [90°/360°] × 100 = 25%

अभीष्ट प्रतिशत = [90°/360°] × 100 = 25%

question: In a class, there are 54 students. \(33\frac{1}{3}\%\) of the number of students are boys and rest are girls. The average score in mathematic of boys in 50% more than that of the girls. If the average score of all the students is 70, then what is the average score of the boys?
question_hi: एक कक्षा में, 54 छात्र हैं। छात्रों की संख्या में \(33\frac{1}{3}\%\)लड़के हैं और बाकी लड़कियां हैं। लड़कियों की तुलना में लड़कों का गणित में औसत अंक 50% अधिक है। यदि सभी छात्रों का औसत अंक 70 है, तो लड़कों का औसत अंक क्या है?
solution:
Given:-

A class of 54 students

Average of mathematic score of boys = 50% more than of girls

Formula used:-

Average = (Sum of values)/No. of values

Calculation:-

Total number of students = 54

\(33\frac{1}{3}\%\) = (100/3)% = 1/3

Number of boys = 54 × 1/3 = 18

Number of girls = 54 – 18 = 36

Average score of girls = 2x

Average score of boys = 2x × (3/2) = 3x

According to the question,

18 × 3x + 36 × 2x = 54 × 70

54x + 72x = 3780

126x = 3780

x = 3780/126 = 30

Average score of boys = 30 × 3 = 90

54 छात्रों की एक कक्षा

लड़कों के गणितीय अंकों का औसत = लड़कियों की तुलना में 50% अधिक

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:-

x = 3780/126 = 30

लड़कों का औसत अंक = 30 × 3 = 90

question: The total number of employees of the company in offices C and D exceeds the number of employees in office B by x, where x lies between:

Calculation:-

Total number of employees in office C and D is = 57.6 + 54 = 111.6°

⇒ \(1\over3\) × \(22\over7\) × 5 × \(7\over2\) × 5 × \(7\over2\) ×12 × \(7\over2\) = 13475 cm3

question: A boat takes 4 hours to travel from a place X to Y downstream and back from Y to X upstream. If the distance from X to Y is 10.5 km, and the speed of the current is 9 km/h, then the speed of the boat in still water, in km/h, is:
question_hi: एक नाव को X से Y के बीच अनुप्रवाह में व Y से X के बीच प्रतिप्रवाह में यात्रा करने में 4 घंटे लगते हैं। यदि X से Y की दूरी 10.5 किमी है, और धारा की गति 9 किमी / घंटा है, तो स्थिर पानी में नाव की गति, किमी / घंटा में है:

Upstream speed = (x - 9) km/h

Downstream speed = (x + 9) km/h

4x2 - 10.5 × 2x - 324 = 0

2x2 - 10.5x - 162 = 0

After solving quadratic equation we get x = 12

question: The internal length of a room is two times its breadth and three times its height. The total cost of painting its four walls at the rate of Rs 25/m<sup>2</sup> is Rs. 3,600. What is the cost of laying a carpet on its floor at the rate of Rs. 90.50/m<sup>2</sup>?
question_hi: एक कमरे की आंतरिक लंबाई इसकी चौड़ाई की दो गुनी है और उसकी ऊँचाई की तीन गुनी है। 25 रुपये/मीटर2 की दर से इसकी चार दीवारों को पेंट करने की कुल लागत 3,600 रुपये है। 90.50 रुपये/मीटर2 की दर से फर्श पर एक कालीन बिछाने की लागत कितनी होगी?
solution:
Given:

The total cost of painting its four walls at the rate of Rs 25/m2 is Rs. 3,600.

Rate 90.50 Rs./m2

Formula used:

The area of four walls, A = 2(l + b)h

Area of floor = l × b

Calculation:

Let length of the room be 6x

Breadth of the room = 6x/2 = 3x

Height of the room = 6x/3 = 2x

Cost of painting Rs. 25/m2

Area of four wall = (1/25) × 3600 = 144m2

Area of four wall = 2(l + b)h

⇒ 2(6x + 3x) × 2x = 144

⇒ 2x × 18x = 144

⇒ 36x2 = 144

⇒ x2 = 144/36 = 4

⇒ x = √4 = 2

Area of floor = l × b = 6x × 3x = 6 × 2 × 3 × 2 = 72 m2

Cost of laying carpet on 1m2 = 90.50

Cost of laying carpet on = 72m2 = 90.50 × 72 = RS. 6516
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

इसकी चारों दीवारों को 25 रुपये प्रति वर्ग मीटर की दर से पेंट कराने की कुल लागत 3,600 रुपये है।

कालीन बिछाने की दर 90.50 रुपये/मीटर2 है।

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

चारों दीवारों का क्षेत्रफल, A = 2(l + b)h

फर्श का क्षेत्रफल = l × b

गणना:

माना कमरे की लंबाई 6x है

कमरे की चोड़ाई = 6x/2 = 3x

कमरे की ऊँचाई = 6x/3 = 2x

पेंट करने की लागत 25 रुपये/मीटर2

चारों दीवारों का क्षेत्रफल = (1/25) × 3600 = 144 मीटर2

चारों दीवारों का क्षेत्रफल = 2(l + b)h

2(6x + 3x) × 2x = 144

2x × 18x = 144

36x2 = 144

x2 = 144/36 = 4

x = √4 = 2

फर्श का क्षेत्रफल = l × b = 6x × 3x = 6 × 2 × 3 × 2 = 72 मीटर2

1 मीटर2  पर कालीन बिछाने की लागत = 90.50

72 मीटर2 पर कालीन बिछाने की लागत = 90.50 × 72 = 6516 रुपये

question: The ratio of expenditure and savings of a person is 5 : 3. If the income increases by 20% and the expenditure increases by 10%, then the person’s savings increase by:
question_hi: किसी व्यक्ति के व्यय और बचत का अनुपात 5 : 3 है। यदि आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है और व्यय में 10% की वृद्धि होती है, तो व्यक्ति की बचत में कितनी वृद्धि होगी?
solution:
Given:

The ratio of expenditure and savings of a person is 5 : 3.

the income increases by 20% and the expenditure increases by 10%.

Calculation:

The ratio of expenditure and savings of a person = 5 : 3

⇒ 50 : 30

Income of person = 50 + 30 = 80

New income of person = 80 × (120/100) = 96

New expenditure of person = 50 × (110/100) = 55

New savings = 96 - 55 = 41

Saving increased by = {(41 - 30)/30} × 100 = \(36\frac{2}{3}\% \)
solution_hi:
दिया गया है:

एक व्यक्ति के व्यय और बचत का अनुपात 5 : 3 है।

आय में 20% की वृद्धि होती है और व्यय में 10% की वृद्धि होती है।

गणना:

एक व्यक्ति के व्यय और बचत का अनुपात = 5 : 3

⇒ 50 : 30

व्यक्ति की आय = 50 + 30 = 80

व्यक्ति की नई आय = 80 × (120/100) = 96

व्यक्ति का नया व्यय = 50 × (110/100) = 55

नई बचत = 96 - 55 = 41

बचत में वृद्धि = {(41 - 30)/30} × 100 = \(36\frac{2}{3}\% \)
